assign.request: Port three more Codrops MIT demos (intro sequence, pointer effect, card stack/carousel) into /imagine/codrops/, then regroup the hub's cards by paging mechanism with one sentence per group. Prove with ui-test at four widths and reduced-motion.
steps: read briefs (round-4, requirements, round-2, round-3, night rules, minion-rules, codrops readme)
find 3 MIT candidates on github.com/codrops (intro, pointer, carousel)

log.msg: 3 MIT repos chosen: codrops/RapidLayersAnimation (intro), codrops/AnimatedCustomCursor (pointer), codrops/ShapesSlideshow (carousel/swap) - all LICENSE files read on master/main branch, all MIT

ui-tested all 3 new pages + hub at 400/1280/1920/3440 and reduced-motion via headless Playwright (scratchpad/codrops-4/test.mjs): zero console errors, no horizontal overflow, all interactions verified with before/after screenshots

regrouped hub: 12 cards sorted into swap(3: circle-reveal, grid-zoom retroactively, shape-swap) / expand(1: expand-menu) / launch(0) / takeover(0) / none(8), one sentence per group reusing MECHANISMS.does; added mechanism column to table

layer-reveal framed as neither takeover nor launch (never routes, never returns to start state) - stays its own 'intro sequence'; found+fixed a transition-delay bug where the closing split inherited the opening stagger

assign.outcome: **Three more MIT Codrops demos ported, hub regrouped by paging mechanism.** [`layer-reveal`](/imagine/codrops/layer-reveal/) — a page-load intro sequence (staggered layer wipe onto a mosaic); fits neither `takeover` nor `launch` (never routes, never returns to start), so it keeps its own name, said plainly on the page. [`warp-cursor`](/imagine/codrops/warp-cursor/) — a pointer-driven custom cursor (SVG `feTurbulence`/`feDisplacementMap`, one SMIL `<animate begin="indefinite">` instead of a GSAP tween), confined to its own stage rather than the whole document. [`shape-swap`](/imagine/codrops/shape-swap/) — a card-stack slideshow framed as this realm's own `swap` (a sixth swap visual: an edge-anchored iris wipe). [`Codrops hub`](/imagine/codrops/) — all 12 cards now grouped under swap(3: circle-reveal, grid-zoom — retroactively recognised, shape-swap) / expand(1: expand-menu) / launch(0) / takeover(0) / none(8), one plain sentence per group, plus a mechanism column on the table. Sources: github.com/codrops/RapidLayersAnimation, /AnimatedCustomCursor, /ShapesSlideshow — LICENSE files read on their default branch, all MIT. Proved with headless Playwright at 400/1280/1920/3440 + reduced-motion: zero console errors, no horizontal overflow, every trigger screenshotted before/after (`shots/`). Left as-is: `grid-zoom`'s own page text doesn't mention `swap` (only the hub's classification was corrected) — a scope call, not an oversight.
